## LivingFrame TV Platform Checklist

- [ ] TypeScript check passes (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] ESLint validation passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Jest unit tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Tested on the **Vega Virtual Device emulator** or physical Vega device
- [ ] Verified TV D-pad remote navigation and focus states
- [ ] Verified responsive layout at 1080p TV resolution
